subject: Animation
title: John Lasseter: From Outcast to Pixar Chief
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on John Lasseter: From Outcast to Pixar Chief.

hook.text: John Lasseter was fired from Disney for pushing computer animation. He then cofounded Pixar and changed everything.

buildup.text: At Pixar, Lasseter directed Toy Story — the first fully computer-animated feature film in history.

discovery.text: Toy Story proved that CGI could carry emotional storytelling, not just flashy visual effects.

twist.text: In 2017, Lasseter was forced out of Disney/Pixar over workplace misconduct allegations.

climax.text: Lasseter's creative legacy transformed animation, even as his personal legacy became deeply complicated.

punchline.text: The man Disney fired came back and revolutionized their industry.

quiz.question: What did John Lasseter accomplish after being fired from Disney?
options: He started a live-action film studio
He cofounded Pixar and directed Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature film
He became a theme park designer

details.summary: John Lasseter was fired from Disney for pushing computer animation, then co-founded Pixar and directed Toy Story, the first CGI feature film. His vision proved that computer animation could tell emotionally resonant stories, transforming the entire industry.
details.whyItMatters: Lasseter's journey from Disney reject to Pixar visionary is one of animation's most important stories. He proved that new technology could serve traditional storytelling, and his early Pixar films set standards the industry still chases.
takeaways: Lasseter was fired from Disney for advocating computer animation
He directed Toy Story, the world's first fully CGI animated feature
His story-first approach at Pixar reshaped the global animation industry

faq.question: Why was Lasseter fired from Disney?
faq.answer: In the early 1980s, Lasseter pushed Disney to combine computer animation with traditional techniques. Management saw it as expensive and unnecessary. They fired him. He joined Lucasfilm's computer graphics division, which became Pixar.

faq.question: What happened to Lasseter's career after Pixar's success?
faq.answer: Lasseter became chief creative officer of both Pixar and Walt Disney Animation Studios. He left in 2017 following misconduct allegations. His creative legacy at Pixar remains foundational, though his departure reshaped the studio's leadership.
